games.title: Royal Ballistix
games.description: Defend a radial gate, capture balls with a magnet and counterattack with Pulse. The v0.9 ten-player source and phone multiplayer integration are pending import.

source.provenance: Known source at CALLBACK commit 50e349b39f2ec458f3e90e7c400464cc2b064ddd; not copied into this repository.

games.title: Royal Roller Ruckus
games.description: A 2–10 contestant rolling-cage physics race on the Vertical Crownway, with momentum handling, collisions, recoverable falls, elevation changes, Crownline boosts, rough terrain and bot-filled seats. Standalone source is imported; authenticated phone-room multiplayer transport is not yet implemented.

source.provenance: Imported from the complete Royal Roller Ruckus v1.4.0 — Vertical Crownway HTML produced in the user's CALLBACK game-development chat. The exact chat build is preserved as source/original-v1.4.0.html. Visuals and prototype audio are procedural/inline; Three.js 0.180.0 is vendored separately under its MIT license.

games.title: Royal Scratch Match
games.description: A DJ rhythm game with approaching notes and A/B/X/Y timing inputs. The v0.5 ten-player HTML attachment is pending import; this catalog entry is not playable.

source.provenance: The chat-mentioned royal_scratch_match_v0.5_ten_player.html attachment is not available in this repository.

games.title: Royal Sumo

source.provenance: The chat-mentioned royal_sumo_crownfall_v0.19_10players.html attachment is not available in this repository.
